description: Verify that the platform has the required active permissions on your pool address. Required: DelegateResource (to sell energy), UnDelegateResource (to reclaim). Optional: VoteWitness (to vote for SRs and earn rewards). Run this after granting permissions to confirm the platform can operate your pool. Requires API key.

poolAddress.description: Pool address to check. If omitted, uses your first registered pool.

name: check_pool_permissions
title: Check Pool Permissions
